integrity: Self-contained analytical proof and standalone diagnostic checker. No independent expert or automated formal proof audit is claimed.
scientific_limitations: The exact four-over-root-fifteen amplification holds on two-supported vectors in period three, not for all vectors. Exact unrestricted norms in periods three and higher are unproved; higher-period perturbation errors are for fixed period. The theorem covers complex periodic coefficient norms only.
title: A sharp dimension threshold for centering in periodic weighted-shift numerical-radius norms
